# Blizz

> Blizz is a simple, WhatsApp-first CRM for small businesses in India and the GCC. It helps sales teams of 3–30 people capture every lead and enquiry, assign it to an owner, set follow-up dates and see the whole sales pipeline in one place. Free for 2 users; paid plans from $7 per user per month.

Blizz is built in India for how small teams in India and the GCC actually sell: enquiries arrive on WhatsApp and phone calls, and teams have agents, team leaders and an owner. It was built first with ReadyMyTrip, a travel agency managing 1,200+ leads, and is also used by Hebe Wellness, a CBD and hemp wellness brand.

## Key facts

- Product: Blizz CRM (web app), https://www.blizz.world
- Category: CRM / lead management software for small businesses
- Market: India and the GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman); one price list in US dollars for India and the GCC; taxes extra
- Best for: travel agencies, pharma and wellness companies, real estate brokers, education consultants, event planners, insurance advisors — teams of about 3 to 30 people
- Not for: large enterprises needing deep customisation, inventory/ERP or prescription management
- Setup: done with the customer on a call; existing leads imported from Excel; teams can be running the same day
- Data: role-based access (agents see their own leads, team leaders their team, owners everything); customers own and can export their data

## Features

- Lead management and sales pipeline with stages
- Follow-up dates and overdue follow-up alerts
- Owner dashboard: new leads, hot leads, overdue follow-ups, revenue, agent leaderboard
- Agents, teams and team leaders, with role-based access and data scoping
- Bulk import from Excel
- Lost-lead tracking
- Coming soon: WhatsApp Business API (two-way messaging), automated follow-ups, GST-compliant quotations and invoices

## Pricing

- Starter: Free — up to 2 users, 500 contacts; WhatsApp enquiries logged by hand (WhatsApp API and automation are on paid plans only)
- Pro: $7 per user per month — unlimited users and contacts
- Business: $14 per user per month — custom fields and stages, API access, dedicated account manager
- No setup fee, no annual lock-in. Full details: https://www.blizz.world/pricing.md
- Example: 10 users on Pro = $840 per year (Zoho CRM Standard $1,680 ($14/user/month billed yearly, Zoho's US-dollar price); HubSpot Sales Hub Professional $10,800 ($90/seat/month billed yearly) + $1,500 mandatory onboarding)
